diagnosis: The tRPC subscription for live patient vitals validates that the WebSocket client has an authenticated user, but registers an observable for any arbitrary patientId passed in the input. Attending care-team assignments or ward permissions are never verified, allowing any authenticated hospital user or contractor to stream live ICU biometrics, bedside alarms, and confidential clinical readings of any patient.
